svg.title: IR traces of an ester, a carboxylic acid and an alcohol
svg.desc: Simulated transmittance traces: ethyl ethanoate shows C=O near 1740 and no O-H; butanoic acid shows a very broad O-H from 2500 to 3300 plus C=O near 1710; ethanol shows a broad O-H near 3350 and no C=O
svg.text: wavenumber / cm⁻¹ · transmittance: dips mean absorption
